# Green Energy Solutions - AI Context

## Overview
Green Energy Solutions is a premier Solar EPC (Engineering, Procurement, and Construction) provider established in 2016 and based in Ananthapur, Andhra Pradesh. We specialize in transforming the way residential, commercial, industrial, and institutional sectors consume energy.

## Mission & Supply
"Powering Progress with Purpose" - We strive to accelerate the transition to sustainable energy by providing innovative, reliable, and cost-effective solar solutions. We provide comprehensive vendor and installation services, exclusively sourcing our solar supplies from **Waaree Energies**, one of the topmost Tier-1 solar manufacturing companies in the industry.

## Core Capabilities
- Solar Consulting & Feasibility
- Engineering & System Design
- Procurement
- Installation & Commissioning
- Preventive Maintenance
- Technical Support
- Asset Management

## Solutions Offered
- Rooftop Solar: Turn unused space into a power asset for residential, commercial and institutional rooftops.
- Ground Mount Solar: High-capacity solutions for commercial and large-scale applications.
- Floating Solar: Innovative water-based installations reducing evaporation and saving land space.
- Solar Pumps & Motors: High-efficiency solar water pumps tailored for agricultural, industrial, and residential water needs.
